description: This file defines functions and structures related to handling packed references (`packed-refs`) in a version control system, likely Git. It includes initialization, locking, unlocking, size querying, and transaction necessity checking for packed references.

methods.name: packed_ref_store_init
methods.description: Initializes the packed reference store for a given repository, setting up necessary data structures.

methods.name: packed_refs_lock
methods.description: Locks the packed-refs file for writing, ensuring exclusive access.

methods.name: packed_refs_unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the packed-refs file.

methods.name: packed_refs_is_locked
methods.description: Checks whether the packed-refs file is currently locked.

methods.name: packed_refs_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the packed-refs file, or zero if it does not exist.

methods.name: is_packed_transaction_needed
methods.description: Determines if a ref transaction needs to be executed on the given packed reference store.
